lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between adjacent blobs in these columns appears relatively uniform, creating a semi-regular grid of local luminance maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a clear grid-like nodal structure along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance pixels on the upper edge to low-luminance shadow pixels immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a yellow-and-black striped pilot fish (Naucrates ductor) positioned near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, and a remora visible below the ventral midline.
